title: The launcher resolves the patched Jackson databind version through the root Maven property

criteria.given: the launcher declares its direct jackson-databind dependency
criteria.then: that dependency uses the root jackson.version property and resolves to 2.22.3

criteria.given: the root project and saiku-bom each define jackson.version
criteria.then: both properties are 2.22.3 so the launcher and BOM stay aligned
